apps.localizedDescription:
vkQuake for iPhone & Apple Vision Pro:

Play Quake on your iPhone and Apple Vision Pro — the full campaign, the mission packs, custom mods, a stereoscopic 3D mode that puts the game on a floating screen in your room with real depth, and a full VR mode that puts you inside it at life scale with a gun in each hand. 100% vibe coded with lots of passion and attention to detail.

Built on vkQuake, the Vulkan-powered engine, running natively through Metal.

vkQuake ships with no game content — you must own Quake and provide your own files. Copy one of these into the app's folder:

• Original Quake — pak0.pak + pak1.pak.

versions.localizedDescription:
vkQuake 1.2.3: fixes the console spam on every mouse click introduced in 1.2.2.

Add one URL to SideStore / AltStore and vkQuake installs and updates itself when new versions ship:

• iPhone / iPad: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rebelancap/quake-ports/main/apps-ios.json (Quake ports) or https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rebelancap/all-ports/main/apps-ios.json (All ports).
• Apple Vision Pro: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rebelancap/quake-ports/main/apps-visionos.json (Quake ports) or https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rebelancap/all-ports/main/apps-visionos.json (All ports).

Or download and sideload manually:

• vkQuake-1.2.3-iOS.ipa — iPhone / iPad (iOS 16+).
• vkQuake-1.2.3-visionOS.ipa — Apple Vision Pro (visionOS 2+).
